title: Final velocities at t₀
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's velocity (2 m/s) and the plank's velocity (3 m/s) at t=1.0 s.

title: Total motion times
description: Essential: Correctly states the total motion time for the block (2.2 s) and for the plank (1.65 s).

title: Minimum plank length
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum length L of the plank as 0.605 m.

title: Force analysis and accelerations
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law to determine accelerations during different phases (e.g., initial sliding, post-force deceleration).

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly analyzes the relative motion between block and plank to find the time they move together and the relative displacements.

title: Kinematic calculations
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematic equations to find velocities, displacements, and times for both objects in each phase.

title: Friction force identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies and applies the kinetic friction forces between block-plank and plank-ground, including their directions.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Makes sign errors in acceleration equations or relative velocity calculations, especially after force removal.

title: Friction confusion
description: Pitfall: Confuses when friction is kinetic vs. static, or misapplies friction coefficients to wrong surfaces.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s², N) throughout all calculations.
